emails.subject: EES Freight Services at VILOG 2026
emails.html:
Hello,

I saw EES Freight Services on the exhibitor list for VILOG 2026 in Ho Chi Minh City. A show like that usually brings new enquiries on top of your regular air, ocean and project freight quoting.

We are Tiph, a software company in London, and we built Kazinga for the quoting side of a forwarder's day. It uses AI to read incoming rate requests, then prices them from your own tariffs and margin, and drafts the reply. Your team checks every quote and sends it. Your data is encrypted, and Tiph cannot read it. More about Kazinga: https://tiph.agency/products/kazinga

We can also set Kazinga up to quote each customer from their own past quotes and orders, as a customisation aimed at raising the value of each account.

Would a 20-minute demo be useful?
